summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K reporting weekly share buybacks under a SEK 15,000,000,000 program announced April 16, 2026, running April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. During June 15-19, 2026, it repurchased 4,805,778 Class B shares at an average price of SEK 112.2492 per share, total daily transaction value of SEK 539,444,797.46. The Board intends to propose to the 2027 AGM to cancel repurchased shares (excluding those for incentive programs). Acquisitions are on Nasdaq Stockholm via Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. The program follows EU Market Abuse Regulation safe harbour rules. Watch for ongoing execution pace and potential cancellation effects on share count.
